title: Aurora Serenity Home
tagline: Family home with pool and partial Arenal views
shortDescription: Spacious four-bedroom house for up to ten guests, with a private pool, terrace and BBQ area in El Tanque, La Fortuna.
description: Aurora Serenity Home is a spacious, elegant vacation house located in El Tanque, La Fortuna, San Carlos, just minutes from downtown and the area's main attractions. Surrounded by nature and offering a partial view of Arenal Volcano, it strikes the perfect balance between tranquility, comfort and a privileged location.

Designed for families and groups of friends, the property features bright, generous spaces. Its open-concept social area brings together a fully equipped kitchen, dining room and living room, flowing directly onto the terrace, the private pool and the BBQ area — perfect for gathering and unwinding.

The house sleeps up to 10 guests across four air-conditioned bedrooms. It offers two full bathrooms, a half bath by the pool, and a cozy standalone TV room, making it comfortable for both short stays and longer getaways.
The garden surrounding the property creates a serene setting where you can enjoy a morning coffee, read a book, or simply unwind while taking in the partial view of Arenal Volcano.

Aurora Serenity Home combines design, space and functionality to offer a comfortable experience in one of Costa Rica's most visited destinations, making it the ideal home base for exploring everything La Fortuna and Arenal Volcano have to offer.
mapQuery: El Tanque, La Fortuna, San Carlos, Costa Rica

title: Volterra House
tagline: Suite with outdoor shower and partial Arenal views
shortDescription: Modern 2-bedroom house just 2 km from La Fortuna's Central Park, with a main suite featuring an outdoor shower and partial views of Arenal Volcano.
description: Volterra House is a modern, peaceful home just 2 km from La Fortuna's Central Park. Enjoy the perfect balance of comfort and tranquility, with the area's main attractions only minutes away.

Thoughtfully designed for couples, families or friends, Volterra House blends modern comfort with the lush beauty of La Fortuna. The house features two spacious bedrooms, each with a king-size bed and air conditioning.

The primary suite is the home's standout feature: floor-to-ceiling windows fill the room with natural light and open onto a private balcony overlooking the surrounding greenery, with partial views of Arenal Volcano on clear days. Its private bathroom offers a unique outdoor shower, where you can unwind under the stars immersed in Costa Rica's tropical atmosphere.

The second bedroom is equally comfortable, with a king-size bed, air conditioning and a relaxing atmosphere. The fully equipped kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area in an open-concept layout, ideal for preparing meals and spending quality time together.
Outside, the property is surrounded by lush tropical vegetation that adds privacy and tranquility, in one of the most beloved areas of La Fortuna.
